_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored). EVERY FIELD IS OPTIONAL - the keyless chain in data/models.json serves with no config at all. Add a key below and that provider's models join the chain automatically; see data/providers.json for the full catalogue of 89 providers with base URLs and signup links.
_keys_comment: provider id -> key. A provider is only used once its key is here. A LIST of keys is rotated one per call.
_multi_key_example: three Gemini keys become 4,500 requests/day instead of 1,500
_providers_comment: Only needed for a provider data/providers.json does not know. base + the model ids you want; it joins the chain when its key is in `keys`.
_compression_comment: off (default) | safe | balanced. Shrinks the prompt before it is sent. `safe` never touches line-numbered file content, template variables, URLs or an edit contract; `balanced` additionally strips comments and minifies JSON, but only from EARLIER turns - never the final user turn, which is where a quoted edit comes from.
